findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Finiteness/Basic.lean:271` has `instance range [Module.Finite R M] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : Module.Finite R f.range`; `TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Subcomodule.lean:343` identifies the comodule range with `LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap`.
findings.fix: Remove this declaration and use `rw [Comodule.Hom.range_toSubmodule]; exact Module.Finite.range f.toLinearMap` or just `infer_instance` at call sites.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Noetherian/Defs.lean:63` defines `IsNoetherian.noetherian : ∀ s : Submodule R M, s.FG`, with `isNoetherian_submodule'` at line 96; `TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Subcomodule/Comap.lean:174` gives `(B.comap f).toSubmodule = B.toSubmodule.comap f.toLinearMap`.
findings.fix: Remove this declaration and use `rw [Subcomodule.comap_toSubmodule]; infer_instance` or `IsNoetherian.noetherian` through the existing submodule API.
findings.issue: `Subcomodule.comap_finite` duplicates the generic noetherian-submodule fact for the submodule `B.toSubmodule.comap f.toLinearMap`.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Noetherian/Defs.lean:63` has the generic finite-generation fact for every submodule of a noetherian module; `TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Subcomodule/Comap.lean:268` identifies the comodule kernel with `LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap`.
findings.fix: Remove this declaration and use `rw [Comodule.Hom.ker_toSubmodule]; infer_instance` at call sites.
findings.issue: `Comodule.Hom.ker_finite` is the same noetherian-submodule wrapper specialized to `LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap`.

summary: The new finiteness API is only thin wrappers around existing Mathlib noetherian/range finiteness facts after the already-present `*_toSubmodule` rewrites.
